articles.summary: New York, NY (September 14, 2026) – Bluerock Homes Trust, Inc. (NYSE American: BHM) (the “Company”) today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized and the Company has declared quarterly cash dividends on the Company’s Class A common stock (the “Class A Common Stock”)...
articles.title: Bluerock Homes Trust (BHM) Announces Third Quarter Dividends on Common Stock
